note: The script asks for seven graphics: the hook text, a name super for each of the five peer specialists the first time he speaks, and the small IPS text card. Every other row is captions only, and the end card is MHA's own.

mg.title: Peer support hook
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, big and bold, top third: “Peer support. Inside a prison.” Off at 00:04.
mg.use: Hook text on frame 1, big, in the top third. Take it off at 00:04, and add no name super for the woman speaking.

mg.title: Herman name super
mg.cue: Name super, 3 s, lower left: “Herman Buckman · IPS peer specialist”
mg.use: Name super for 3 seconds, the first time Herman speaks. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line IPS peer specialist under it.

mg.title: Daniel name super
mg.cue: Name super, 3 s, lower left: “Daniel Miller · IPS peer specialist”
mg.use: Name super for 3 seconds, the first time Daniel speaks. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line IPS peer specialist under it.

mg.title: IPS text card
mg.cue: Small text card over this line: “IPS · Intentional Peer Support”
mg.use: Small text card over this man's line, in the top band. Put it on at the start of this row and hold it up to 10 seconds, with the captions as usual.

mg.title: La'Ron name super
mg.cue: Name super, 3 s, lower left: “La'Ron Jones · IPS peer specialist”
mg.use: Name super for 3 seconds, the first time La'Ron speaks. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line IPS peer specialist under it.

mg.title: Leonard name super
mg.cue: Name super, 3 s, lower left: “Leonard Rondu · IPS peer specialist”
mg.use: Name super for 3 seconds, the first time Leonard speaks, lower left above the captions. If this row is cut, drop the super too. Type the second line IPS peer specialist under it.

mg.title: Robert name super
mg.cue: Name super, 3 s, lower left: “Robert Norfolk · IPS peer specialist”
mg.use: Name super for 3 seconds, the first time Robert speaks. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line IPS peer specialist under it.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: Intentional Peer Support. Inside the walls, and outside them., then mha-ne.org under it, dark olive #4A5325. Add the MHA turtle logo only fr
mg.src: MHA Nebraska has not sent a logo file (never rebuild one), so the end card is the script's words in MHA's colours.

text.name: Intentional Peer Support
lines: Inside the walls, and outside them.

mg.use: This is the end card. Put it at 02:12 after the last line and hold it to the end.
